scope: File-type scope failures for PHP embedded in media
observation: A GIF89a file with an appended PHP system($_GET["cmd"]) call was identified as GIF. Its extracted media facts contained container, valid, and problems, but no media.php.request_calls field. The PHP-open-tag rule matched; the structured request-command rule did not.
implication: The three request-call rules cannot detect this sample with the current fact producer. Their broad media file-type scope cannot be resolved safely by narrowing it or by merely granting an exemption.
next: Trace the actual fact producer and carrier support, implement or select binding-aware PHP request-to-call evidence for media, verify true and false cases for each supported carrier, and then resolve matcher-type scope validation without changing the caps.
